fewShots.question: What were total sales by product category last calendar year?
fewShots.query:
SELECT p.ProductCategory,
       SUM(f.SalesAmount) AS TotalSales
FROM FactSales f
JOIN DimProduct p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
WHERE YEAR(f.OrderDate) = YEAR(GETDATE()) - 1
GROUP BY p.ProductCategory
ORDER BY TotalSales DESC;

fewShots.question: Which countries grew fastest year over year?
fewShots.query:
WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT c.CountryRegionName,
           YEAR(f.OrderDate) AS CalendarYear,
           SUM(f.SalesAmount) AS SalesAmount
    FROM FactSales f
    JOIN DimCustomer c ON f.CustomerKey = c.CustomerKey
    GROUP BY c.CountryRegionName, YEAR(f.OrderDate)
)
SELECT CountryRegionName,
       CalendarYear,
       SalesAmount,
       LAG(SalesAmount) OVER (PARTITION BY CountryRegionName ORDER BY CalendarYear)
           AS PriorYearSales
FROM yearly
ORDER BY CountryRegionName, CalendarYear;
